candidate.rationale: The new prophecy value is intentionally unconstrained so it can predict any value later supplied to resolve; no useful non-vacuous postcondition is sound.
risks: Constraining proph_var@ would conflict with resolving the prophecy to an arbitrary exec-computed T value.

candidate.rationale: Intentional nondeterminism is essential: new allocates a prophecy whose view may later equal any exec-computed T supplied to resolve. With no inputs or observable allocation property, every universally sound postcondition is tautological or semantically unusable.
risks: Any nontrivial constraint on proph_var@ would exclude valid later resolutions and contradict resolve's arbitrary-value contract.
